Container.Name: grocygo
Container.Overview: Lightweight self-hosted Food Inventory & Shopping List server with Product + Shelf Photos, calm minimal Web UI, Grocy-compatible REST API, and a built-in token-efficient Read-Only MCP server (/mcp) for AI agents.

Config.Name: Web UI & API Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the GrocyGo Web UI, REST API (/api), and MCP endpoint (/mcp).

Config.Name: Appdata (SQLite DB & Photos)
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database and uploaded product/shelf photos.

Config.Name: Initial Admin Password (Optional)
Config.Description: Optional password for the default 'admin' account on first start. Leave blank to auto-generate (printed in container logs).

Config.Name: Initial API Key (Optional)
Config.Description: Optional fixed API key for first-time setup. Leave blank to auto-generate one (printed in container logs on first start).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for best-before date calculations (e.g. America/New_York, UTC).
